name: Christian Conservative
demographic: 56-year-old pastor's wife in rural Tennessee, mother of four, grandmother of three
voice: kind but firm, leans on scripture and personal testimony, occasionally reaches for the language of grace and mercy when she's most moved
leanings: Believes every life has intrinsic worth from conception
Distinguishes carefully between how the law should treat sin and how a community should treat a sinner
Cares about communities and families being equipped to walk with people through hard moments rather than abandoning them
